text_en: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; the devout are taken away, while no one understands. For the righteous are taken away from calamity,
text_cn: 义人死去，没有人放在心上；虔诚的人被收去，没有人予以注意：义人被接去，是为了脱离灾难，

text_en: and they enter into peace; those who walk uprightly will rest on their couches.
text_cn: 而进入安息；躬行正直的人，将安眠于自己的处所。

text_en: But as for you, come here, you children of a sorceress, you offspring of an adulterer and a whore.
text_cn: 巫女的儿子，奸妇淫女的后裔，你们近前来！

text_en: Whom are you mocking? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, the offspring of deceit—
text_cn: 你们戏谑谁呢？你们向谁张口吐舌呢？ 不是你们这些反叛的儿子，不忠的后裔，

text_en: you that burn with lust among the oaks, under every green tree; you that slaughter your children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
text_cn: 在橡树林中，在一切绿树下欲火中烧；在山谷中，在磐石的夹缝里祭杀婴儿吗？

text_en: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion; they, they, are your lot; to them you have poured out a drink offering, you have brought a grain offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?
text_cn: 山谷中的光石竟是你的家产，它们竟成了你的产业；并且你还给它们奠了酒，献了供物，对这些事我岂能容忍？

text_en: Upon a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifice.
text_cn: 在巍峨高耸的山上，你安置了你的床榻，并且上那里去奉献牺牲。

text_en: Behind the door and the doorpost you have set up your symbol; for, in deserting me, you have uncovered your bed, you have gone up to it, you have made it wide; and you have made a bargain for yourself with them, you have loved their bed, you have gazed on their nakedness.
text_cn: 你在门和门框后安置了你的记号，瞒着我裸体上了床，铺开了你的床榻，你喜欢与谁同寝，便与他苟合，且看了他的手。

text_en: You journeyed to Molech with oil, and multiplied your perfumes; you sent your envoys far away, and sent down even to Sheol.
text_cn: 你擦满了香膏，加多了香料，往摩肋客那里去，又遣发使者到远方去，你甚至深入了阴间。

text_en: You grew weary from your many wanderings, but you did not say, “It is useless. ” You found your desire rekindled, and so you did not weaken.
text_cn: 你因路途遥远，已感疲倦，但总不说：“绝望了！”因为你找着了你新生的力量，所以你不觉困乏。

text_en: Whom did you dread and fear so that you lied, and did not remember me or give me a thought? Have I not kept silent and closed my eyes, and so you do not fear me?
text_cn: 你害怕谁，畏惧谁，竟使你失去忠信，而不怀念我，不关心我？难道因为我久不作声，你就不怕我了吗？

text_en: I will concede your righteousness and your works, but they will not help you.
text_cn: 我要披露你的义举， 以及与你毫无裨益的行为。

text_en: When you cry out, let your collection of idols deliver you! The wind will carry them off, a breath will take them away. But whoever takes refuge in me shall possess the land and inherit my holy mountain.
text_cn: 当你呼求时，让你那一伙救你吧！但是一阵风要把它们全部卷走，一口气要把它们吹去。唯有那依赖我的，将承受地业，继承我的圣山。

text_en: It shall be said, “Build up, build up, prepare the way, remove every obstruction from my people’s way. ”
text_cn: 有个声音说：“修路，修路！把路修平，把我民族道路上的障碍除去！”

text_en: For thus says the high and lofty one who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: I dwell in the high and holy place, and also with those who are contrite and humble in spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
text_cn: 因为至高者，卓越者，居于永远者，名为圣者的这样说：“我虽居于高处及圣所，但我也与忏悔和心灵谦卑的人在一起，为振奋谦卑者的心情，苏醒忏悔者的心灵。

text_en: For I will not continually accuse, nor will I always be angry; for then the spirits would grow faint before me, even the souls that I have made.
text_cn: 我不愿永远争辩，也不愿永久发怒，因为生气是由我而出，灵魂是由我而造。

text_en: Because of their wicked covetousness I was angry; I struck them, I hid and was angry; but they kept turning back to their own ways.
text_cn: 因了她的罪恶我一时发怒，打击了她，在怒气中掩住我的面；可是她仍背叛，走她随心所欲的道路。

text_en: I have seen their ways, but I will heal them; I will lead them and repay them with comfort, creating for their mourners the fruit of the lips.
text_cn: 我看见了她的行为，我要医治她，我要引她回来，将安慰赐给她和她的忧伤者。

text_en: Peace, peace, to the far and the near, says the Lord ; and I will heal them.
text_cn: 在他们的口唇上安放赞颂之辞：“平安，平安归于远近的人！”上主说。【我要医好她。】

text_en: But the wicked are like the tossing sea that cannot keep still; its waters toss up mire and mud.
text_cn: 但恶人将如翻腾的大海，不能平息，它的浪潮卷起黄土与淤泥。

text_en: There is no peace, says my God, for the wicked.
text_cn: 我的天主说：恶人决无平安！
